title: What the AI teacher knows about this problem
help: AI writes hints and common mistakes for this problem, and Cove tests every mistake with real programs. The AI teacher uses them when it analyses a student's code; students never see them directly. You do not have to write anything; edit or hide an item to change what the AI teacher says.
off: AI is not on for this problem. It needs the academy's AI assistant, the AI feedback checkbox above, and automatic Python grading.
failed: The AI library could not be loaded.

state.NONE: Not learned yet. The AI starts right after you save the problem.
state.CHECKING: Cove is running the test programs.
state.REVIEWING: A second AI check is reading it.
state.FAILED: No library. Students still get the error coach, rules and personalized feedback.

stale: The problem changed, so students do not see these items until the new ones are ready.

error.SOLUTION_FAILS: Your own solution fails this problem's tests. Check the solution or the tests.

regenerate_failed: Could not ask for a new library. Try again.
conflict: Someone else changed this item. It has been refreshed.
wrong_program: Wrong program used to test it

mistakes.title: Common mistakes, last 30 days
mistakes.unmatched: AI answers that matched no known mistake: {{total}}

reason.WRONG_PASSES: Its wrong program passes the tests, so it is not a mistake
reason.NOT_RUN: Its wrong program could not be tested
reason.NO_REVIEW: The second check did not answer
reason.TOO_FEW: Too few good items to publish
reason.EXTRA: More mistakes than a library keeps

blocked.FEATURE_OFF: The AI teacher is not on for this academy.
blocked.COURSE_OFF: This course does not include the AI teacher. Turn it on in the course settings.
blocked.PROBLEM_OFF: AI is off for this problem. Turn on "AI teacher for this problem" above.
